formulas.roe: PAT / average net worth (equity capital + reserves)
formulas.cash_conversion_3y: sum of cash from operations over 3 years / sum of PAT over 3 years
formulas.inventory_days: 365 x average inventory / cost of goods sold
formulas.payable_days: 365 x average trade payables / cost of goods sold
formulas.cycle_days: receivable days + inventory days - payable days

claims.claim: Executed over 50% of the opening order book and achieved highest-ever H1 revenue of approximately INR 160 crore.
claims.quote: In H1, we executed over 50% of our FY '27 opening order book while achieving our highest-ever H1 revenue of approximately of INR 160 crore.

claims.claim: Achieved Q2 revenue of approximately INR 91 crore with sequential growth and a return to PAT profitability.
claims.quote: During Q2, we achieved revenue from operations of approximately INR 91 crore, representing sequential growth over the previous quarter and return to profitability at the PAT level.

claims.claim: Demonstrated long-range ISR capabilities up to 100 kilometers and 6+ hours of flight time in field testing.
claims.quote: In field testing, the platform demonstrated long-range ISR capabilities of up to 100 kilometers and 6+ hours of flight time with an advanced ISR payload and electronic warfare resilience.

claims.claim: Signed an agreement with the Technology Development Board for INR 151 crores in debt funding under the RDI scheme.
claims.quote: We also signed an agreement with the Technology Development Board for INR 151 crores in debt funding under the Government of India's RDI scheme.

claims.claim: Q2 revenue from operations stood at INR 91.3 crores, up 124% year-on-year and 33% sequentially.
claims.quote: For Q2 FY '27, consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR 91.3 crores, up by 124% year-on-year basis and 33% on sequential basis.

claims.claim: Closing order book as of September 30 stood at INR 202.2 crores.
claims.quote: Our closing order book as of 30th September stood at INR 202.2 crores compared to the corresponding period, INR 256.8 crores in Q1, reflecting the continued execution of our existing orders.

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst asked about the INR 151 crore funding terms, interest rate, and company's own contribution.
analyst_concerns.quote: The first question is on the INR 150 crore funding that we are getting for YETI platform. So sir, why is this number INR 151 crore? Is that the overall development expenditure that we are anticipating, or in addition to INR 151 crore, are we also putting in our own money in that? Also, what are the terms of this? Is this a loan? And if it is, what is the interest rate that we are going to pay?

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst asked which product or category drove the impressive INR 91 crore revenue execution.
analyst_concerns.quote: All right. And sir, what is the reason why we have done such impressive execution of INR 91 CR? So what is that product or category that is helping us drive such revenues? Is it the SWITCH platform or something that I might have missed?

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst pressed on export scale-up, NATO opportunities, and the Blue SUAS certification update.
analyst_concerns.quote: Can you please help us with the scale-up that is happening on the export side? Any kind of opportunity that we are looking from the NATO countries? And if there is any update on the Blue SUAS certification that we were going to receive?

analyst_concerns.question: Analyst asked how development-phase combat drones qualify for emergency or command-level procurement tenders.
analyst_concerns.quote: So, my first question is regarding the combat drones. We said that we are in the development phase. So, how does this the whole cycle happen? So, for example, we are made to understand that there is an emergency procurement and also the command level procurement which is happening. So, since you are in the development phase, will you be qualified for the particular tender or how does the entire system work?

commitments.target: Blended gross margin would likely hover between a 50%, 55% range for this year.
commitments.quote: So, Deeya, while we do not disclose or give forward-looking projections on the numbers of top line, as we have also noted historically that for this year, our blended gross margin would likely hover between a 50%, 55% range.
commitments.speaker: Vipul Joshi

claims.claim: Delivered over 20% of opening order book, recording INR68.6 crores revenue and positive EBITDA.
claims.quote: First, we delivered more than 20% of our FY27 opening order book, recording revenue from operations of INR68.6 crores and closed the quarter with a positive EBITDA.

claims.claim: Entered FY27 with an opening order book of more than INR300 crores.
claims.quote: On the execution and order book front, we entered FY27 with an opening order book of more than INR300 crores, and our priority for the year is conversion of the opening order book into revenue.

claims.claim: Deployed UAV fleet crossed 1 million customer missions during the quarter.
claims.quote: Third, our deployed UAV fleet crossed 1 million customer missions.

claims.claim: Raised INR500 crores through a qualified institutional placement.
claims.quote: Fourth, we secured the capital required to fuel our next phase of growth, raising INR500 crores through a qualified institutional placement and receiving a Letter of Intent for financial assistance of up to INR151 crores for our middle-mile logistics UAV YETI under the Government of India's RDI Scheme.

claims.claim: Gross margin stood at 49% for the quarter.
claims.quote: Gross profit stood at INR33.6 crores compared to INR7.9 crores in Q1 FY26 with a gross margin of 49% in the quarter and 61.7% in Q1 last year.

analyst_concerns.question: What is the scale-up in US operations and expected market size?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, if you can help us with the scale up that is happening in your export and US operations. And what kind of market and opportunity size can we expect from your US operations? And if you can give us some number around it?

analyst_concerns.question: Where is the disconnect causing slow government order movement?
analyst_concerns.quote: So where is the disconnect or where is the gap from the government expectations or from some criticality that order movement is slow, not only for you but the entire drone space as a whole? So, can you help us understand that a little bit?

analyst_concerns.question: How is YETI placed compared to competitors like BluJ Aero in the logistics drone RFI?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, I want to understand how YETI is placed in that RFI that has been released by the Indian Army. And how different or similar is BluJ Aero logistics drone with the YETI, if you can add some comment on that?

analyst_concerns.question: Will gross margin pressure continue due to supply chain issues over the next two quarters?
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, my question was that considering the challenges or the pressure we've seen in Q1 with respect to gross margin and the fact that you're looking at executing the order book we have over the next 2 quarters and geopolitical issues or the supply chain constraints are not resolving anytime soon, do we expect this pressure to continue while we execute this order book?

unverified.target: Complete delivery of the remaining order book of INR256.8 crores by Q3.
unverified.quote: While global supply chain disruptions and component availability continue to pose challenges, we remain focused on completing delivery of the remaining order book of INR256.8 crores by Q3 as per customer timelines.

claims.claim: During Q4, the company executed around 40% of the open order book from Q3, recording highest ever quarterly revenue and profit.
claims.quote: During the quarter, we executed around 40% of our open order book of Q3, recording our highest ever quarterly revenue and profit after tax and closed FY '26 with positive EBITDA.

claims.claim: FY26 was the strongest year in history for order inflows, booking approximately INR530 crores of orders.
claims.quote: FY '26 was the strongest year in our history in terms of order inflow. We booked approximately INR530 crores of orders across defence and civil customers

claims.claim: Q4 revenue from operations stood at INR141 crores and gross profit at INR95.4 crores with 67.6% margin.
claims.quote: For Q4 FY26, revenue from operations stood at INR141 crores compared to INR20.3 crores in quarter 4 FY25. This was our highest quarterly revenue so far. Gross profit for the quarter stood at INR95.4 crores with a gross margin of 67.6%.

claims.claim: Opening order book for FY27 stood at approximately INR310 crores as of March 31, 2026.
claims.quote: As of 31st March '26, our opening order book for FY '27 stood at approximately INR310 crores.

claims.claim: The deployed fleet completed over 250,000 end customer flights in FY26 and crossed 950,000 cumulative flights.
claims.quote: Our deployed fleet completed over 250,000 end customer flights in financial year '26 and crossed 950,000 cumulative flights.

analyst_concerns.question: What is the order size, platform end-user, and localization strategy for the U.S. JV?
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, we have received first U.S order in Q4, I think JV with First Breach. Like, if could you explain what is the order size and platform end user and like, how you are aligned with this JV? If you could throw some light on that JV localization strategy?

analyst_concerns.question: What are the customer segments, timelines, and offensive capabilities for YETI and combat drones?
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, on the development side, I need to understand about YETI and offensive EW payloads and active development side. First thing in YETI, I think which are our customer segments in logistics, heavy lift or resupply? And when we can expect a significant revenue in YETI Logistics?

analyst_concerns.question: Which specific subsystems or components are most at risk based on current geopolitical conditions?
analyst_concerns.quote: And second thing on the supply chain side, which specific subsystems or components are at risk based on the current geopolitical side?

unverified.target: blended gross margin of 50% to 55% for FY27
unverified.quote: My expectation as a blended for the year, roughly about 50% to 55% is our hope for the year.

commitments.target: Delivering around 40% to 45% of the open order book in the present quarter and recognizing the revenue.
commitments.quote: However, our readiness makes us confident of delivering around 40% to 45% of the open order book in the present quarter and recognizing the revenue.
commitments.speaker: Ankit Mehta

commitments.target: Gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for FY26.
commitments.quote: We are confident in the full year's gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for 'FY '26', supported by our order mix and execution of higher-value programs in Q4.
commitments.speaker: Ankit Mehta

claims.claim: Year-to-date, added INR440 crores of orders, the highest single-year quantum in our 2-decade journey.
claims.quote: Year-to-date, we have added approximately INR440 crores of orders to our order book, the highest quantum of orders in a single year in our 2-decade journey.

claims.claim: As of quarter end, order book was INR350 crores, standing at approximately INR368 crores with current month additions.
claims.quote: As of the end of the quarter, our order book was approximately INR350 crores. And with the addition in the current month, it stands at approximately INR368 crores.

claims.claim: Q3 order inflow was broad-based with over INR102 crores from large opportunities and INR115 crores from smaller orders.
claims.quote: In Q3 alone, the order inflow was broad-based. We added more than INR102 crores through large opportunities and roughly INR115 crores through multiple smaller orders.

claims.claim: Secured capital emergency procurement orders from Indian Army worth over INR100 crores for ZOLT and SWITCH UAVs.
claims.quote: During the quarter, we secured capital emergency procurement orders from the Indian Army worth more than INR100 crores for our tactical class ZOLT UAV and mini UAV SWITCH.

claims.claim: Deployed UAVs completed over 150,000 flights with end users up to December 2025 and over 850,000 cumulatively.
claims.quote: Our deployed UAVs have completed more than 150,000 flights with our end users in the field during the period up to end of December 2025 and over 850,000 flights cumulatively.

analyst_concerns.question: Pressed on whether private partners act as prime bidders and who bears working capital and bank guarantees.
analyst_concerns.quote: So can you help us understand whether these partners act as a prime bidder or as a facilitator or -- and also specifically who bear the deposit bank guarantee and working capital in such cases?

analyst_concerns.question: Asked how deep the local content audit goes into Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers.
analyst_concerns.quote: Like, for example, does it stop at ideaForge or it extend to Tier 1, Tier 2 suppliers? Like for instance, if you source from an Indian electronics partner who in turn uses imported components, how is the indigenous content evaluated?

analyst_concerns.question: Asked whether ideaForge is working on solar-powered drones with 24-hour endurance.
analyst_concerns.quote: So are we also working in this area? And also on the YETI drone, so when do we expect this prototype to be ready? That was also the question I asked in the last call.

analyst_concerns.question: Asked if drones can carry electronic warfare payloads to jam or attack enemy radars.
analyst_concerns.quote: I wanted to understand, can our drones essentially carry the electronic warfare payload and then enter the enemy airspace and jam the -- or possibly spoof or completely attack the enemy radar system.

annual.what_it_does: Ideaforge Technology Ltd develops and manufactures uncrewed aerial systems (UAVs) and drones. It provides resilient, high-performing drones and related software, analytics, and services for defense, civil, and enterprise applications.

segments.name: Defense
segments.note: Defense sector UAV sales and solutions

segments.name: Civil
segments.note: Civil and enterprise sector UAV sales and solutions

annual.customers: Defense, civil, and enterprise customers including military and police forces.

facts.fact: As of June 30, 2026, ideaForge had an intellectual property portfolio of 112 patents (61 granted and 51 pending).
As of March 31, 2026, ideaForge had a workforce of 536 employees.

annual.geography: Primarily India, with emerging international expansion including the US and Japan.
annual.revenue_mix_basis: Share of revenue by customer category for FY 2025-26

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlighted record quarterly performance in Q4 FY26 driven by executing open order book.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q4 FY26 revenue reached Rs 141.04 crore with PAT of Rs 59.99 crore, recovering from losses in earlier quarters.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: C1 stated achieving highest H1 revenue of ~INR 160 crore and returning to PAT profitability in Q2.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: H1 FY27 revenue totaled Rs 159.88 crore, and Sep 2026 quarter PAT turned positive at Rs 6.46 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported record FY26 order inflows of INR 530 crore showing strong commercial demand.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 total revenue stood at Rs 226 crore with a net loss of Rs 17 crore and low OPM of 2.7%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management cited strong operational momentum and Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 124% year-on-year.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Sep 2026 revenue rose to Rs 91.29 crore, but 5-year cash conversion ratio remains negative at -1.19.

bull.point: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 124% YoY to Rs 91.29 crore with positive PAT of Rs 6.46 crore and order book of Rs 202.2 crore.
Secured INR 151 crore debt funding from Technology Development Board and raised INR 500 crore via QIP to strengthen liquidity.
Strong IP portfolio of 112 patents (61 granted) as of June 2026 supports proprietary UAV technology position.

bear.point: Cash flows remain severely negative with 3-year cumulative FCF at -Rs 307 crore and FY26 CFO at -Rs 63 crore.
Working capital cycle stretched to 498 days in FY26, driven by elevated inventory days of 445 days.
Annual profitability is volatile, with full-year net losses of Rs 62 crore in FY25 and Rs 17 crore in FY26.

watch.point: Execution pace of the INR 202.2 crore closing order book in Q3 FY27.
Blended gross margin trajectory toward the target range of 50% to 55% for FY27.
Progress on international scale-up, US JV localization strategy, and Blue SUAS certification status.
